init_reader_agent: initialize a Reader agent with an optional config path for docstring context analysis
process_code_component: process a code component to determine if more context is needed for docstring generation
use_code_component_type_enum: use the CodeComponentType enum to classify code as function, method, or class
create_information_request: create an InformationRequest dataclass with internal and external request lists for structured queries
review_reader_system_prompt: review the Reader agent system prompt to understand internal codebase and external retrieval information sources
